description: What tools/actions.py may bind an action to on the Vita handheld variant. Read only by Python tooling at build time; the engine never sees this file. Derived from engine/include/platform/vita/handheld/Platform.h's TranslatePadButtons, which promotes the two shoulder-trigger bits onto L1/R1 and masks L2/R2 out entirely, and from the handheld hardware itself, which has no clickable-stick L3/R3. HasTouchSurfaces() is true here (front and rear panels); PlatformCapability::AnalogTriggers is false for the whole Vita family, so there are no trigger sources.
